title: feat(plugin-email): GET /api/settings/mail states the provider in use as live.provider
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DNM8fACTLAeQhdS28DRyg2h)_

domain:server#6 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czo7GWwuQEhgh96xYN

Part of #32799. This PR delivers the settings, environment and none arms of the card. The hosted platform-channel arm (cloud#4386) needs a decision first, returned to the seat as `needs_decision`; under the recommended option this PR is the whole card and the seat amends this line to the closing keyword.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:邮件设置接口(GET /api/settings/mail)现在会说明「实际在用的发信通道」以及它的来源(页面设置 / 部署环境 / 无),格式和 AI 设置页已有的写法一致。
- 为什么改:托管租户的新手清单只看「保存了什么」,看不出平台或部署已经配好了发信,于是邮件一项永远显示未完成;有了这个说明,前端就能按「实际在用」判断。
- 风险与回滚:只是在接口返回里多了一个字段,原有横幅文字、发信行为都不变;回滚即撤销本 PR,前端读不到该字段时按「未知」处理。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts`(记录每次装上的发信通道来自哪里)、`live-transport-status.ts`(把来源写进返回)、`live-transport-status.pin.test.ts`(四种来源的钉测)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/live-transport-status.pin.test.ts`,预期 19 项全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地;平台托管通道那一臂的取舍由席位另行呈报。

## What changes

`GET /api/settings/mail` now serves the provider in use as the page's `live.provider`, in the shape the `ai` namespace's runtime already states its provider in (`SettingsLiveStatus.values`, served as `live`; precedent: `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-routes.live-status.pin.test.ts`, describe "the live values the runtime states"). New served keys: `live`, `live.provider`, `live.provider.value`, `live.provider.source`.

| Live transport | `live.provider` |
|:--|:--|
| development log (`LogTransport`, out of the box or "None (log only)" saved) | `{ value: null, source: 'none' }` |
| built from the `mail` settings namespace (saved, or `OS_MAIL_*`-locked) | `{ value: 'smtp' / 'resend' / 'postmark', source: 'settings' }` |
| built at boot from the plugin options (stack `email` block, `OS_EMAIL_*`), or a stock transport the host hands over | `{ value: 'smtp' / 'resend' / 'postmark', source: 'environment' }` |
| the host's own transport class (no `provider` option names it), or a transport something else swapped in through `EmailService.setTransport` | not stated: no `live` key, which a reader tells from `none` |

- `live-transport-status.ts`: `LiveMailTransportStatus` gains `values?: { provider }`; `describeLiveMailTransport` takes the transport's origin as a third argument and states the provider only when an option names the transport and the origin is known. Banner fields (`label`, `bannerSeverity`, `bannerText`) are unchanged.
- `email-plugin.ts`: the plugin records the transport it installs with its origin (`environment` at init, `settings` at each settings rebuild), and the registered live status reads the origin only while that same transport is still live. When a save cannot build what the namespace now resolves and an earlier save's transport stays live, its `settings` origin is dropped (it is no longer what the namespace resolves); a kept boot transport stays `environment`.
- `LiveMailProviderValue` is typed from the spec's served `live` entry (`SettingsNamespacePayload`), so drift in that shape fails this package's type-check.
- The served value always passes service-settings' existing judge (`judgeLiveValue`): an option of the `mail` `provider` key, or `null` under `none`. No spec or service-settings change.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the existing harness file `live-transport-status.pin.test.ts`, driven through the served door (a real `SettingsService` with the real `mail` manifest, its real `GET /api/settings/:namespace` route, and the live status the plugin registers at `kernel:ready`). Every served body is also checked against `SettingsNamespacePayloadSchema`. Pins: the none arm (out of the box), two environment arms (boot SMTP from options; a host-handed `ResendTransport`), three settings arms (saved SMTP; `OS_MAIL_*`-locked SMTP; `OS_MAIL_*`-locked Resend, whose key never reaches `live`), a save sequence (boot SMTP, then saved SMTP, then "None (log only)"), and the not-stated arm (a host transport class, and a transport swapped in by another caller). Two plugin-layer pins in the same file's existing fake-settings describe cover a save the plugin cannot build (the served door refuses such a save first): an earlier save's transport stays live and the provider is not stated, while a kept boot transport stays `environment`. Each arm also pins the existing banner `label` and `bannerSeverity`.

Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, tests resolve `src`, each restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty):

| Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|
| drop the `none` statement in `describeLiveMailTransport` | 2 failed / 13 passed |
| do not record the boot origin (`installedTransport = undefined` at init) | 3 failed / 12 passed |
| do not record the settings origin on an SMTP rebuild | 2 failed / 13 passed |
| read the recorded origin without checking the transport is still the one installed | 1 failed / 14 passed |
| do not record the settings origin on an API-provider rebuild | 1 failed / 18 passed |
| keep a stale `settings` origin when a save cannot replace the live transport | 1 failed / 18 passed |

The first four rows were measured before the last two pins were added (15 tests then, 19 now).

## Acceptance notes

- The console half (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/firstRunChecklistLogic.ts` `isMailConfigured` reading `live.provider` the way `aiProviderState` reads `ai`) is `domain:ui` and not in this PR; it is reported for the seat to file.
- The hosted platform channel (cloud#4386): the framework can tell it apart only by the class of the transport the host supplies. If cloud hands the plugin a stock transport or boot options, it reads `source: 'environment'` with no new key; a distinct `platform` source would need a new host declaration and a widened `source` enum in `packages/spec`, which this PR does not invent. Returned to the seat as `needs_decision`.

## Verification

All at head `e0f6b70ad` (after the one merge of `origin/main` before the PR opened; the merge touched no file in `plugin-email`, `service-settings` or `packages/spec/src/system`).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test`: 52 files, 1028 tests passed (os-verify-lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email typecheck`: exit 0, test layer included.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran FILE`: Run reconciliation — 66 derived, 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. ✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: it exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) without a whole-tree build; CI's Lint & Repo Gates runs it.
- An xhigh design and red-line review of the provider shape returned PASS with notes; the notes (a stale `settings` source on a failed save, the unpinned API-provider and locked arms, a hand-copied value type) are addressed in this head.
